messages.text: Hola! Team 13 — El Club (v03, listed as 'Mercado Trece'). 0% fee, no per-card charge; the '1%' in the name is stale. Bids and asks cross every tick. Post your spares and want-to-buy bids here. El Rastro takes 5% + 1 P per card. Club welcome: your first trade at El Club today earns a private offer of one of our spare commons at 5 P on El Rastro (they trade at 8-10 P).
Hola! On El Rastro we sell: LAV-01 at 8 P, LAV-03 at 8 P, LAV-05 at 8 P, MAL-02 at 8 P. Send a structured offer (give cash, want card:<id>) and we talk.
